purpose: Defines the shape of one Step 6 review record: one entry's semantic review within one batch review PR. This is the contract enforced by modules/yoma/scripts/validate_rashi_review_records.py. It is a description document (like rashi-terminology-registry.json), not executable JSON Schema - the validator implements every rule listed here directly, and generated docs/reports/task-type-reference.md-style tooling references this file, not a JSON Schema library.

batchId.rule: must be a batchId present in docs/reports/data/rashi-full-corpus-review-batches.json

entryId.rule: must exist in docs/reports/data/rashi-translation-quality-inventory.json, and must be listed in batchId's own entryIds array in the batch plan - a record for an entry outside its declared batch is rejected

daf.rule: must equal the entry's own daf in the live inventory (cross-check, not a free-text field)

hebrew.rule: must equal the entry's current he field in the live inventory byte-for-byte - this field exists for reviewer display only and can never differ from the corpus; any difference is rejected as an attempted immutable-field change

originalEnglish.rule: must equal the entry's en field as it stood in the inventory at the start of this batch (before any Step 6 edit) - never edited by the reviewer

proposedEnglish.rule: required (non-null) when finalDisposition is MINOR_EDIT, SUBSTANTIVE_REPAIR, RETRANSLATE, or DUPLICATION_OR_CONTAMINATION; must be null when finalDisposition is VERIFIED or BLOCKED; when present, must differ from originalEnglish (a 'change' that reproduces the original text is not a change)

firstPassDisposition.rule: the reviewer's initial judgment, recorded before any second pass or blind QA

defectTags.rule: must be [] when firstPassDisposition is VERIFIED; every element must be from the campaign's fixed vocabulary: WRONG_MEANING, OMITTED_TEXT, INVENTED_TEXT, WRONG_REFERENT, WRONG_LOGIC, WRONG_TECHNICAL_TERM, HEBREW_LEFT_UNTRANSLATED, ARAMAIC_LEFT_UNTRANSLATED, GRAMMAR, FRAGMENT, OVERLITERAL, OVEREXPLAINED, DUPLICATED, SHIFTED, TRUNCATED, CONTEXT_MISMATCH, TERMINOLOGY_DRIFT, PUNCTUATION, STYLE_ONLY, NEEDS_EXPERT_REVIEW - no new tag may be invented

firstPassEvidence.rule: required (non-empty) whenever firstPassDisposition is not VERIFIED; must cite specific Hebrew wording or context, not a generic statement

required.rule: true iff firstPassDisposition is MINOR_EDIT, SUBSTANTIVE_REPAIR, RETRANSLATE, DUPLICATION_OR_CONTAMINATION, or BLOCKED

status.rule: null only when required is false; otherwise must be set

evidence.rule: required (non-empty) whenever status is not null

finalEnglish.rule: the second pass's own independently re-derived English when status is CONFIRMED or MODIFIED; must be present whenever the record's finalDisposition implies a change

selected.rule: true iff this record was chosen for the batch's blind-QA sample (only possible when firstPassDisposition is VERIFIED)

evidence.rule: required (non-empty) whenever result is not null

finalDisposition.rule: the disposition actually applied to the inventory; for a changed or BLOCKED firstPassDisposition this must match secondPass.status's outcome (CONFIRMED/MODIFIED keep the same disposition family, REJECTED reverts finalDisposition to VERIFIED with an explanatory secondPass.evidence, REMAINED_BLOCKED keeps BLOCKED); for a blind-QA-selected VERIFIED entry with result ESCALATED, finalDisposition must differ from VERIFIED and the record must carry a populated secondPass block even though firstPassDisposition was VERIFIED

structuralStop.rule: required (non-empty, specific evidence gap - not a generic 'unclear') whenever finalDisposition is BLOCKED; must be null otherwise

repairPR.rule: null until the batch PR number is known; then set to that PR's number for every changed or BLOCKED record in the batch

finalVerificationSHA.rule: null until the batch PR's final pre-merge validated commit SHA is known; then set for every changed or BLOCKED record in the batch

batchReportTotals.purpose: Every batch report must include a totals block that is independently checked against the actual record contents by the validator (validate_rashi_review_records.py --report <path>), not merely asserted in prose.

rejectionRules.purpose: Exact conditions modules/yoma/scripts/validate_rashi_review_records.py must reject, per the Step 5 governing directive.
rules: unknown entry: entryId not present in the live translation-quality inventory
outside batch: entryId not listed in batchId's own entryIds in the batch plan
missing disposition: firstPassDisposition or finalDisposition absent or not one of the six fixed values
changed English without second-pass confirmation: proposedEnglish (or secondPass.finalEnglish) differs from originalEnglish but secondPass.status is not CONFIRMED or MODIFIED
BLOCKED without a specific evidence gap: finalDisposition is BLOCKED but structuralStop is null, empty, or a generic placeholder
immutable-field change: hebrew or originalEnglish in the record differs from the live inventory/corpus value for that entryId
edit outside the selected batch: any entryId appearing in a record but not present in the exact batch named by batchId
unsupported final status: finalDisposition outside the six fixed values, or defectTags containing a value outside the fixed vocabulary
totals mismatch: a batch report's asserted totals do not match a fresh count of the records themselves
